description:
Mark Lawless Auctioneers are delighted to present this detached four-bedroom bungalow, set on approximately 2.9 acres in a peaceful countryside location near Ticknevin Bridge, North Kildare.
Positioned along the canal bank and approached by a long private driveway, the property enjoys wonderful rural views and convenient access to scenic canal-sidewalks. The residence offers excellent potential for purchasers wishing to enhance the property and create a wonderful family home in a tranquil countryside setting.
Extending to approximately 118 sq. m, the accommodation comprises an entrance hall, sitting room, spacious kitchen and dining area, four bedrooms and a main bathroom.
The grounds include five horse boxes and a hay barn, making the property particularly appealing to equestrian enthusiasts or anyone requiring generous outdoor space and useful outbuildings.
The property is located just outside the village of Derrinturn, within easy reach of local amenities. St Brigid’s National School is less than one kilometre away, while Dublin is approximately 55 kilometres from the property.
This is a unique opportunity to acquire a detached countryside home on substantial grounds, with superb potential and an enviable setting beside the canal.
